notes.title: ⚔️ Keep of the knights is released now! ⚔️
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, noble warriors![/b]
The wait is over — Keep of the Knights has officially launched! It's time to gather your bravest troops, buy your finest armor, sharpen your deadliest swords, and ride into battle. Rally your forces, defend your keep, and carve your legend into the annals of history.
Victory awaits those bold enough to seize it.
The battlefield is calling... will you answer?
